verdicts.observation: 'Net Damage' is translated as 基础伤害, which means base damage. In the pinned source (tome game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/throwing-knives.lua@624a6732, knivesInfo lines 174-196), the displayed value is dmg = self:combatDamage(combat). combatDamage gives the net damage after stat modifiers (dammod), so it is not base damage. The label should say net or actual damage (for example 实际伤害), not 基础.
